protocol_metadata.about: Curve LlamaLend (also called Curve Lending) is a permissionless one-way lending protocol where users can deposit any token as collateral to borrow crvUSD, or supply crvUSD to earn interest. It is built on top of LLAMMA, Curve's soft-liquidation AMM mechanism, which gradually converts collateral to crvUSD as prices fall rather than triggering immediate hard liquidations. Markets are created via factory contracts (OneWayLendingFactory on Ethereum, OneWayLendingFactoryL2 on L2s) and are governed by the Curve DAO through an ownership agent and emergency multisig. The protocol is deployed on Ethereum (48 markets), Arbitrum, Fraxtal, and Optimism.
